basis: On 2026-11-17 the user requested 4096 environments, a longer behavior-evaluation interval, and then cancellation of automatic stops for behavior-evaluation failures. The default and maximum interval are 100 updates. Valid behavior failures are recorded and training continues; runtime/evaluation-data errors, resource reserves and user interruption still apply. The 4096-environment run completed 100 updates with all eight ascents completed and no falls or stalls; its only retention failure was keyboard-flat speed 0.664365 m/s versus the 0.669547 m/s threshold. This is not proof of long-run hardware stability. Historical files, checkpoints and acceptance thresholds are preserved.
